title: Can you count
your agents?
cover.standfirst: This issue asks a simple operating question,
cover.standfirstStrong: can you name what each agent can touch, decide, evidence and switch off?

graphic.label: Decision graphic
graphic.kicker: Before the next agent goes live
graphic.title: An agent register should answer five questions
graphic.subtitle: A board cannot govern an agent it cannot trace to a system, a decision and a named owner.

steps.head: Systems and data
steps.text: Which systems does it touch, and what data can it reach?

steps.head: Decision authority
steps.text: Which decisions can it take without a human?

steps.head: Budget and approval
steps.text: Whose budget does it sit on, and who approved it?

steps.head: Evidence
steps.text: What does it leave behind for an auditor?

steps.head: Switch-off authority
steps.text: Who can restrict or stop it when the work goes wrong?

graphic.callout: One agent, one record, one named owner with the authority to act.
